name: MERCY Malaysia
summary: Medical and humanitarian relief organisation that responds to disasters and runs longer-term health, recovery and risk-reduction work for vulnerable communities in Malaysia and abroad.
programmes: Emergency medical response to disasters and conflicts
Early recovery and rebuilding of health services
Disaster risk reduction and preparedness training
Islamic social finance channel for zakat, sadaqah and waqf
impact: 14 psychosocial first aid training sessions in 2025
beneficiaries: Communities hit by disasters and crises in Malaysia and overseas, including flood evacuees and people in conflict zones

organisation.founders: Dr Jemilah Mahmood, Malaysian obstetrician and gynaecologist, set it up with a few like-minded friends
organisation.leadership: Dato' Dr Ahmad Faizal Mohd Perdaus (President); Prof Dr Shalimar binti Abdullah (Vice President I); Razi Pahlavi bin Abdul Aziz (Vice President II); Dr Mohamed Ashraff bin Mohd Ariff (Vice President III); Reza bin Abdul Rahim (Hon. Treasurer); Prof Dr Nazimah binti Idris (Hon. Secretary); Zuraidah Mian (Acting Executive Director); Royal Patron: the Sultan of Perak
organisation.accounts: Annual Report 2025 with condensed audited financials (auditor Jeffrey Suffian, unqualified opinion): https://mercy.org.my/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/MERCY-MALAYSIA-ANNUAL-REPORT-2025-UDPATED.pdf; also 2024 https://mercy.org.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Annual-Report-2024.pdf, 2023, 2022 on https://mercy.org.my/resources/
